Would you ever consider journaling about how this ritual affects your mood? (e.g., " Today, the careful eyeliner made me feel confident in my meeting" or " I skipped it today and felt..."). It might deepen your appreciation for this small but mighty practice. You’re doing something truly wise. Keep honoring that. ✨
